name: Linear

verdict.topBlocker: Missing or mismatched redirect URI configuration in the Linear developer portal.
verdict.summary: Linear provides a self-serve developer portal for creating OAuth applications, making it straightforward to integrate. No formal marketplace review is required for private or public distribution, allowing for immediate deployment.

steps.title: Create OAuth Application
steps.detail: Navigate to Settings > API > Applications in your Linear workspace to create a new OAuth application.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs
steps.detail: Register your application's callback URLs in the Linear developer settings. Ensure these match your implementation exactly.

steps.title: Store Credentials
steps.detail: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret. The secret is only displayed once; store it securely in your environment variables.

steps.title: Implement Authorization Flow
steps.detail: Redirect users to the Linear authorization URL with required parameters: client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code, and requested scopes.

steps.title: Handle Token Exchange
steps.detail: Exchange the authorization code for an access token and refresh token via a POST request to the token endpoint.

steps.title: Set Distribution to Public
steps.detail: Update the application settings to 'public' if you intend for other workspaces to install your integration.

requirements.note: You must have a Linear workspace to manage the OAuth application.
Redirect URIs must be absolute HTTP or HTTPS URLs.

scopes.note: Default read access for the user's account.
Full access to admin endpoints; use only if strictly necessary.
Allows the app to be assigned as a delegate on issues.

blockers.cause: The authorization flow was not completed within the 10-minute window.

blockers.symptom: Failed to exchange code for token
blockers.cause: Mismatched redirect URI or incorrect client secret.
blockers.unblock: Verify the redirect URI in the developer portal matches the request exactly and ensure the secret is correct.
